verdict.rationale: incident.io documents its own Workflows feature, which triggers actions on events, such as automatically publishing to the status page when an incident is updated. Further rule-based automation appears in escalation-path rules keyed on priority and working hours, and in bidirectional ticket syncing on change. The evidence shows only one Workflows example, so the breadth of user-defined trigger conditions and actions is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of the Workflows rule builder (trigger types, conditions, action catalog), multiple trigger/action examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: With Workflows, you can automatically publish to your status page when an incident is updated.
You can now set up rules around priority and/or working hours to ensure you page the right people at the right time without causing additional noise.
You can now configure incident tickets to update the incident when the ticket changes, as well as updating the ticket when the incident changes.
Automatically create incidents from Datadog monitors
